gen-fs-quilon-gf-sulphur-point: Commanding and editorial, Quilon lets its strokes swell and thin with a gentle ebb. Sulphur Point sits beside it with a marker-like line and a rounded-nib look, a plain sans that feels sturdy and slightly blunt next to that shaped heading.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-tiktok-sans: Quilon brings an editorial, commanding voice with mellow stroke shifts. TikTok Sans follows with tall lowercase nearly reaching cap height, and that sturdy, modern sans is the pair's strongest quality: confident up top, low-contrast below.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-ubuntu-sans: Quilon is at its best when its strokes taper like a sharpened pencil line, with big open shapes in a, e and s. Ubuntu Sans does its work in tubular, ruler-straight strokes with huge lowercase eyes.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-vend-sans: Quiet stroke modulation gives Quilon its editorial authority. Big and short is where it earns its keep, while Vend Sans, a plain sans with a ruler-drawn line and no contrast at all, supplies the flat counterpoint.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-yaldevi: Mild thicks and a gentle ebb of stroke weight mark Quilon as editorial and commanding. Yaldevi answers with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, a sans whose clean, low-contrast manner is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-ol-c: Bold and contemporary, Red Hat Display draws a constant marker-like line with daylight in every curve. Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds its curve tails back and packs words into low, solid blocks, a sans built for steady text rather than showy headings.
gen-fs-rx-100-gf-cascadia-code: Compact, futuristic letters up top, then wide-spaced wire below. Cascadia Code is a plain sans with a monoline skeleton and smooth bends, so a long passage would feel spread out and unobstructed beside RX100's crowded run.
gen-fs-rx-100-gf-cascadia-mono: Futuristic and tightly packed, RX100 has a dominant x-height and no stroke contrast whatsoever. Cascadia Mono stands in pin-like letters beside it, a sans where capitals blend into lowercase.
gen-fs-rx-100-gf-julius-sans-one: Tight, tall, unmistakably futuristic. RX100 crowds its letters together while Julius Sans One drifts in the opposite direction, with wide gaps and open-ended curves, so the two feel like compression and release on the same page.
gen-fs-rx-100-gf-lexend-giga: A dominant x-height and crowded, zero-contrast letters make RX100 instantly recognizable. And Lexend Giga, a plain sans with flat linework and generous tracking, gives that density room to breathe, which is the pair's strongest quality.
